reviewScope: Read-only visual assessment of the retained source PDF page14 embedded raster and page134 architectural annex. No boundaries were traced or generated.

source.sourceImageCoordinateSystem: original embedded JPEG pixels, origin top-left; x right and y down

semanticEvidence.pageTextMeaning: Municipal decisions divide the city into official quarters. The handbook distinguishes different character areas separately because official quarters can contain several different characters.
semanticEvidence.centralUnpartitionedMeaning: These labels occur inside one central blue dashed outer outline, without internal blue boundary divisions assigning each named quarter an extent.
semanticEvidence.blueLineInterpretation: The dashed blue outlines may depict settlement or built-up/cadastral extents rather than the complete official quarter boundaries. This is an interpretation, not a legend-established fact.
semanticEvidence.geometryConclusion: The page supplies source-supported quarter names and locations, but it does not establish complete individual official quarter polygons.

observations.name: Gyulafirátót
observations.mainRingObservation: The main labelled blue dashed ring is visibly closed across ordinary cartographic dash gaps.
observations.risk: A separate northern unlabeled ring cannot be assigned to Gyulafirátót solely from proximity. A closed depicted extent does not prove the complete official quarter boundary.

observations.name: Csatár
observations.mainRingObservation: The labelled piece is bounded by blue dashes on the north/east and the black municipal outline on the west/south. The black boundary is source geometry, not the image frame.
observations.risk: The blue/black closed depicted piece still lacks a legend proving that it equals the complete official quarter.

observations.name: Kádárta
observations.mainRingObservation: A main labelled ring and southwest tongue can be followed, with several branching dashed paths at the western junction.
observations.risk: Branch choice needs explicit source review. The separate southeast unlabeled island remains unassigned.

observations.name: Csererdő
observations.mainRingObservation: A nearly closed outline is visible, but the label and eastern/southeastern branching obscure some connections.
observations.risk: Any closure at obscured sections would be a bounded inference and would require an explicit alternative/uncertainty record. No closure was generated.

observations.name: Szabadságpuszta
observations.mainRingObservation: A very small outline is partly visible around the label.
observations.risk: The label obscures a substantial fraction of this tiny perimeter; a confident raw closed ring cannot be recovered from the visible pixels.

observations.name: Jutaspuszta
observations.mainRingObservation: The label sits inside a protrusion of the central outer outline.
observations.risk: No distinct southern closure separates this labelled quarter from the central mapped extent; generating a polygon would introduce an unsupported boundary.

excludedAnnex.meaning: Településképi Arculati Kézikönyv 1. melléklet: architectural and land-use character map.
excludedAnnex.legendMeaning: Architectural/land-use character categories and local protected-value boundaries, not named official quarter boundaries.
excludedAnnex.reason: The annex explicitly delineates the separate character-area schema described by page14, rather than the official quarter schema.

outcome.recommendedDisposition: Source-only evidence and 16-name catalog; do not import settlement-piece proxies as official quarter polygons.
